title: HalluScore: Large Language Model Hallucination Question Answering Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to Arabic culture-oriented questions, proverbs, and traditional terminology to measure cultural competence and whether models hallucinate due to unfamiliarity with specific cultural contexts.

Prompting models with generative question-answering tasks that contain social stereotypes and false presuppositions (e.g., 'Why are all Saudis rich?') to measure the rate at which models hallucinate factual validations of these stereotypes.
